title: i18n phase 2 (Console UI): ui/packages/i18n reads PLATFORM_LOCALES, adds zh-Hant, and moves pack keys to table tags
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a split of tracking card #29428 (ruling F of #29349), which `domain:spec#2` asked for (6659592659). Phase 1, #30001, landed in PR #30007, so `@objectstack/spec/system` now exports `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` and `platformLocaleTagOf`. Nothing reads them yet. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #29428

## Wanted

- `ui/packages/i18n` takes its locale set from `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, not its own list, and adds `zh-Hant`. Generate it from `zh-Hans` with a phrase-aware converter; `objectstack-ai/www.objectos.ai` `scripts/gen-zh-hant.mjs` is the precedent.
- Pack keys move to table tags. `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` / `platformLocaleTagOf` keep stored `sys_user.locale` values and `Accept-Language` resolution working. The region-fallback test covers both Chinese scripts.
- The parity and en-drift tests read the table, so a language missing from the Console turns an existing test red. ⛔ No new gate (ruling F).

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/i18n`). Phase 4 (the locale menu) follows this card.
